answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
